name: Torr2Jelly
description: Standalone TorrServer torrent streaming & Prowlarr/Torznab integration for Jellyfin
overview: Stream torrents instantly on Jellyfin without waiting for downloads. Features embedded zero-config TorrServer daemon, Prowlarr search, and automated .strm library generation.

versions.changelog: Customizable search & individual tracker toggles, default English UI with instant Ukrainian toggle, editable STRM naming templates, server category synchronization & series auto-routing fix, and ultra-fast targeted scanning (<1s) via ILibraryMonitor.
Visual UI refinements: native gradient buttons, modern custom checkboxes, line clamping for release titles, and accurate status text for external TorrServer.
Jellyfin search integration: automatically suggests torrents from Prowlarr/Torr2Jelly when searching in Jellyfin, with 1-click addition to library.
Fix Jellyfin player error by replacing &preload with &play parameter in .strm files; default to external TorrServer (VPN) and allow disabling embedded daemon.
Fix getApiUrl/getAuthHeaders JavaScript scope error in Jellyfin SPA; clean modular global handlers for search, direct torrent additions, and library synchronization.
Fix search form submission in Jellyfin SPA: prevent native form reload, add direct window.t2jDoSearch handler on button and Enter key.
Inline onclick tab and action handlers with direct global state dispatch to guarantee button clicks work in Jellyfin SPA.
Fix Jellyfin querySelector('div[data-role=page]') stripping: moved style, fontawesome, and runner script inside the page div wrapper.
Fix Jellyfin SPA rendering: embed complete CSS styling and JS controllers directly in HTML without external link/controller dependencies.
Rich Glassmorphism UI redesign matching torr2jelly web app, Gold/Freeleech filters, direct TorrServer stream URLs, and automated defaults.
Initial standalone release with embedded TorrServer daemon and Prowlarr integration.
